title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1998 13.5.2 Out of the 9 cases under investigation by the police, which include cases under investigation from previous years, investigation could be completed in 5 cases. The remaining 4 cases are still under investigation. Charge sheets were submitted in 6 cases in the year 1995, 3 cases in 1996, 4 cases in the year 1997 and 3 cases in 1998. However, out of the 14 cases meant for trial in the year 1998, only in 5 cases trial were completed. All these (5) cases ended in acquittal after trial. The low rate of disposal of cases by the court, which is 35.7% throws a big question mark on the law and order situation in the country and the image it creates in the minds of public about prevailing criminal justice system.
